items.reason: Inclusion admits 'glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype and the WHO Grade 4 of astrocytoma, IDH-mutant by WHO 2021 classification'; IDH-mutant grade 4 astrocytoma is not glioblastoma under CNS5 (§1.1 notes), so two glioma types are eligible with glioblastoma named.

note: Trial stays included either way; the population value only affects the GBM-only sensitivity analysis. Placebo listed only by coder B (priority 3, not adjudicated here).
